text:
Anya (PM): Heads-up — need a call on sequencing for the Q3 'Developer Onramp' work. Customers are asking both better Console onboarding and deeper API capabilities. Do we do Console-first (fast visible wins) or API-first (long-term developer ergonomics)?
Kevin (Eng): API-first makes sense for unit economics long-term. Console wins are superficial and might require rework later. Did a quick RICE sketch.
Drew (Design): Console templates reduce friction for non-dev buyers and make demos much clearer. Sales closes faster with them. Lower upfront dev cost too. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Olivia (Sales): +1 for console templates — Enterprise A is blocked on RBAC/audit in the Console. If we push API-only they'll delay purchasing. Can we do minimal console admin + API SDK improvements?
Sam (Infra): API batching and routing changes touch runtime, need kernel selection tests and QA. ETA ~6 weeks for safe rollout. Console templates + telemetry looks like ~3 sprints.
Maria (PM): Proposal: split into two deliverables — "Console Onramp MVP" (templates, telemetry, RBAC hooks) and "API improvements v1" (basic batching + docs). Sequence Console MVP first, then API v1 with a canary.
Kevin (Eng): If Console goes first we need a traffic-safe preview mode (rate-limited) so heavy demo usage doesn't hit production. Otherwise ops will be paged.
Anya (PM): Quick RICE notes I put together:
```
Console Onramp MVP: Reach=7, Impact=6, Confidence=70, Effort=4 -> RICE=(7*6*0.7)/4 ~= 7.35
API batching + docs: Reach=6, Impact=8, Confidence=60, Effort=8 -> RICE=(6*8*0.6)/8 ~= 3.6
Console RBAC+audit (enterprise hook): Reach=3, Impact=5, Confidence=80, Effort=5 -> RICE=(3*5*0.8)/5 ~= 2.4
```
Drew (Design): :thumbsup: Those numbers align with design's timebox. Suggested success metrics: demo->trial conversion +15%, time-to-first-inference <= 5 min for Console flows.
Maria (PM): Launch criteria (Console MVP): 3 template flows, telemetry + trial funnel, RBAC hooks callable from API; acceptance = signup -> token -> first inference <= 5m in test env.
Kevin (Eng): API v1 acceptance criteria: correct batching semantics, e2e perf tests, canary at 10% traffic, auto-fallback to legacy path on errors.
Olivia (Sales): Sequence Console->API works for sales. We'll use templates in upcoming demos. Call out any compliance blockers early.
Sam (Infra): Runtime note: batching requires kernel profiling on target instance types. Recommend starting the profiling work in parallel to avoid a hard dependency.
Anya (PM): Decision: sequence = Console Onramp MVP (ship target: 6 weeks) then API improvements v1 (start canary week 10). Owners: @Drew (Design), @Kevin (Eng), @Sam (Infra). Any objections?
Kevin (Eng): No objections, I'll create the epics and add estimates.
Drew (Design): +1
Maria (PM): +1
Olivia (Sales): :thumbsup: Sales looped in.
Sam (Infra): Acknowledged — starting profiling tasks this week.
Anya (PM): Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc and add the launch criteria to the spec.
